Profiles

Which profile is on the house

Why the profile matters

A blocked quad gutter spills over the front and stains a wall. A blocked box gutter or valley has nowhere outward to go and sends the water inside.

How to tell which you have

If you can see the gutter from the footpath it is almost certainly quad. If the roof line is flat or there is a parapet, there is probably a box gutter behind it.

What it changes about the schedule

Box gutters and valleys get cleared on a cycle rather than when somebody notices, because by the time anybody notices it is a ceiling repair.
